m12g.run:
The man in the attached reference, rapping at night under a concrete road flyover in London, grey pillars and sodium streetlight behind him, a wet kerb at his feet. Low wide-angle lens close to him, waist-up, framed in the right third, the pillars bending slightly at the frame edges. He is hunched forward from the hips, shoulders high and rounded, face turned to the lens, chin jutting. His right gloved hand is caught mid-jab, one finger stabbing short and quick at the camera, blurred with motion; his left hand hangs hooked at his hip. Knees soft, feet planted. Cold breath in the air. Candid music-video still, hard orange streetlight from above, deep shadow.
Thanks.

s01g.run:
The man in the attached reference, rapping at night in a narrow London brick alley, black wheelie bins against one wall and a wall vent breathing steam under a single lamp. Very low wide-angle lens pointing up at him, chest-up, framed in the left third, his head near the top edge and the alley walls leaning in. He is hunched and rounded, leaning toward the lens, head cocked to one side but facing the camera. He wears thick, full black winter gloves that cover every finger to the tip, like the gloves in the reference. His right gloved thumb is jabbed back into the middle of his chest mid-poke; his left gloved hand is low at his belly, palm down, starting to move. Both hands stay well below his chin. Knees bent, feet planted. Candid music-video still, warm lamp against cold blue dark.
Thanks.
